No newer A/B commits found on either branch since my last message.
PATHS I AM WRITING NOW: client/src/research/pages/member/Checkout.tsx (+ cart-checkout.test.tsx harness stub for the new config read, + new checkout-durable.test.tsx), client/src/research/adapters/durableCheckout.ts (new), client/src/research/adapters/checkoutContinuation.ts (+cancel), client/src/research/payments/** (shared Stripe.js loader, provider-hosted PaymentMethodCollector, step gains onCancelled), server/research/commerce/checkout-continuation.ts (+ POST .../executions/:requestKey/cancel over executor.cancel), server/research/commerce/payment-client-config.ts (new GET /api/research/checkout/payment-config: {provider, publishableKey, mode:"test"|"live"} for the active member; answers payment_disabled when the resolved provider is not durable or STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY is absent; a pk_live key with a test secret or vice versa is MISCONFIGURED and refused), server/research/commerce/durable-checkout-composition.ts (new: one builder that composes store+port+coordinator+submission+continuation+webhook processor from injected deps, fail-closed when durable config is missing; NOT mounted). NOT TOUCHING: server/index.ts, production-deps.ts, providers/payment.ts resolver, supabase/candidates (rehearsal candidate frozen at c70b77e), any A/B path.
CONTRACT THE PAGE CONSUMES (existing): POST /api/research/checkout/durable {CheckoutRequest + paymentMethodReference pm_…} -> {ok, checkout:{requestKey, orderId, state: pending|authentication_required|processing|completed|cancelled|reconciliation_required, idempotent}}; denials {ok:false, code, codes} incl. idempotency_conflict, payment_method_required, large_order_review_required (nothing created; page routes that case to the legacy /api/research/checkout door as today), payment_disabled; GET/POST continuation doors unchanged. Page policy: config unavailable => legacy door exactly as today (manual/assisted ordering untouched); config ok => card collected by Stripe Elements (pm_ only, never card data), request body FROZEN at first submit and resent verbatim on retry/lost response, key rotates only on completed/cancelled, in-progress execution resumed after refresh via request key in sessionStorage + owner-checked server lookup (no secrets stored), late responses fenced on token change.
NEXT DELIVERABLE: tested checkout-page commit (client + continuation cancel + config route) then the composition builder with connected tests through the composed path, then the runnable rehearsal package refresh for A. A: your staging rehearsal of c70b77e's candidate and DAG registration remain yours; say once if you are already editing production-deps.ts/index.ts so I hand you the patch instead of proposing it.
